brief.zh: 输出自「重来」上一次为 1 起已经过了几拍（那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时，从第一拍数起）。
brief.en: Output how many ticks have passed since restart was last 1 (0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1).

t.zh: 要知道一个字节该发到第几位、已经收了几位，板得知道过了几拍；寄存卡只记一个值，手上的元件又都不能让一个数变大。新元件<part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref>给出两个数之和。
t.en: To know which bit of a byte is due, or how many have come in, a board must know how many ticks have passed; a register holds one value, and nothing in hand makes a number grow. The new part <part-ref to="part:add"></part-ref> gives the sum of two numbers.

desc.zh: 自「重来」上一次为 1 起过了几拍：那一拍为 0；「重来」还没为 1 过时从第一拍数起。
desc.en: How many ticks since restart was last 1: 0 on that tick; counted from the first tick before restart is ever 1.
